requirements: R1: Resolve HTTP 401 errors on the report generation endpoint
R3: Implement Moodle role hierarchy synchronization
R4: Implement autonomous fallback for external LMS failure

slices.title: Implement missing Moodle SSO and fix 401 errors
slices.jtbd: When implementing omitted requirements for this epic, I want to patch the HTTP 401 error and implement Moodle SSO features, so that the self-falsification finding is resolved
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated request to report generation, When the endpoint is called, Then it returns 200 instead of 401.
Given a user logs in via Moodle SSO, When they authenticate successfully, Then their roles are synchronized.
Given the external LMS is down, When a user logs in, Then they can use the autonomous fallback.
